summary: All four printed problems (Практически кръг: 2, Наблюдателен кръг: 2) are present with verbatim statements, quantities (π=0".077, P=104 d, H=74 km/s.Mpc, G, pc, M☉) and the Frost poem preserved; solutions are correctly taken from solutions p.2 (the Международна олимпиада section) and match the print; all four figure crops contain the complete figures without clipping. The catalogue/solutions-title mismatch (catalogue says Национална олимпиада IV кръг, solutions p.2 heads the same tasks as Международна олимпиада — САО, Русия) is correctly surfaced as a caveat rather than silently fixed.

defects.description: Catalogue attributes the paper to Национална олимпиада 1998 IV кръг, but the solutions page for these exact tasks is headed „МЕЖДУНАРОДНА ОЛИМПИАДА — РЕШЕНИЯ - САО, РУСИЯ“. The candidate preserves round:null and records the disagreement in paper.caveat — correct handling of a genuine source/catalogue conflict.

Official solution prints the mass unit as M with subscript „з“ (M_з, nonstandard for solar mass); candidate preserves it verbatim and documents the reading in answer.note — correct preservation of a printed quirk.
